name: Heinz Kohut
shortBio: Austrian-American psychoanalyst who founded Self Psychology, re-theorizing narcissism as an autonomous developmental line and defining selfobjects and empathetic attunement.
centralQuestion: How do selfobject experiences of mirroring, idealizing, and twinship preserve the coherence, vitality, and harmony of the nuclear self against disintegration anxiety?

keyWorks.title: The Analysis of the Self
keyWorks.description: Landmark monograph introducing mirror and idealizing transferences in the psychoanalytic treatment of narcissistic disorders.

keyWorks.title: The Restoration of the Self
keyWorks.description: Formalizes self psychology as an independent conceptual framework replacing classical drive psychology.

keyWorks.title: How Does Analysis Cure?
keyWorks.description: Posthumous text defining optimal frustration, transmuting internalizations, and empathetic understanding as the curative agents.
